# Risk Framework

Use this framework to identify and control startup execution risk.

## Risk Register

Score each risk:
- Impact: 1 (low) to 5 (critical)
- Probability: 1 (unlikely) to 5 (likely)
- Risk score = Impact x Probability

| Risk | Category | Impact | Probability | Score | Leading Indicator | Mitigation | Owner |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| [Risk 1] | Product | [ ] | [ ] | [ ] | [Signal] | [Mitigation] | [Owner] |
| [Risk 2] | Market | [ ] | [ ] | [ ] | [Signal] | [Mitigation] | [Owner] |
| [Risk 3] | Technical | [ ] | [ ] | [ ] | [Signal] | [Mitigation] | [Owner] |
| [Risk 4] | Operational | [ ] | [ ] | [ ] | [Signal] | [Mitigation] | [Owner] |
| [Risk 5] | Financial | [ ] | [ ] | [ ] | [Signal] | [Mitigation] | [Owner] |

## Common Risk Categories

- Product risk: Wrong feature priority, weak user value
- Market risk: Demand assumptions fail, segment mismatch
- Technical risk: Architecture complexity slows delivery
- Operational risk: Team bandwidth, process breakdowns
- Financial risk: Burn rate vs milestone timing
- Compliance/trust risk: Legal, fraud, policy, reputation

## Mitigation Standards

Each mitigation should include:
- Preventive action (before risk materializes)
- Contingency action (if risk triggers)
- Monitoring cadence (daily/weekly)
- Owner and decision threshold

## Weekly Risk Review

Review all score >= 12 weekly.

For each high risk, answer:
- Is probability rising, stable, or falling?
- Are indicators improving?
- Do we need scope/timeline changes now?
